summary: The article accurately reports on SEBI's relaxation of NISM certification requirements for non-advisory roles, including the introduction of new, lighter modules and their effective dates. The details regarding the fees and study hours for the older certifications are also largely correct.

claims.claim: SEBI has now introduced a 'lighter' certification module for these non-core personnel.
claims.note: SEBI has indeed introduced a lighter NISM certification module for sales and non-core staff in investment advisory roles.

claims.claim: For Persons Associated with Investment Advice (PAIA) who perform only sales and other non-core services, they shall now obtain certification by passing the "NISM Series–XXV-B: Persons Associated with Investment Advice (Sales and Other Non-Core Services) Certification Examination".
claims.note: SEBI circulars and NISM communiques confirm the introduction of NISM Series XXV-B for PAIA performing sales and non-core services.

claims.claim: Similarly, for Persons Associated with Research Services (PARS) in non-core roles, a "NISM Series-XXV-A: Persons Associated with Research Services (Sales and Other Non-Core Services) Certification Examination" has been introduced.
claims.note: NISM has launched the NISM Series XXV-A for PARS performing sales and other non-core services.

claims.claim: The NISM-Series-XXV-B: Persons Associated with Investment Advice (Sales and Other Non-Core Services) Certification Examination will be available to the candidates with effect from June 01, 2026.
claims.note: The NISM website confirms the launch date of NISM Series XXV-B as June 1, 2026.

claims.claim: The NISM-Series-XXV-A: Persons Associated with Research Services (Sales and Other Non-Core Services) Certification Examination will be available to the candidates with effect from February 10, 2026.
claims.note: NISM announced the launch of NISM Series XXV-A with effect from February 10, 2026.

claims.claim: The revised guidelines are effective immediately, fostering greater ease of doing business in the Indian securities market.
claims.note: Multiple sources, including Livemint and Business Standard, confirm that the provisions of the SEBI circular came into force with immediate effect.

claims.claim: Each of these certifications typically involves: Study Time: Approximately 40-60 hours per module. Exam Fee: Around ₹1,500 per module.
claims.note: The NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors) exam fee is ₹1,500. The NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives) exam fee is also ₹1,500. Study time estimates are general but reasonable for these certifications.

claims.claim: Let's assume this lighter module requires: Study Time: Approximately 20 hours. Exam Fee: Around ₹1,000.
claims.note: The NISM Series XXV-B exam fee is ₹1,500, not ₹1,000. The NISM Series XXV-A exam fee is also ₹1,500. While the study time of 20 hours is an assumption in the article, the actual assessment for both new modules is 50 questions in 60 minutes, suggesting a shorter preparation time than the more comprehensive exams.

article_title: SEBI Eases NISM Certification for RMs & Sales Staff
